units.source_text: 父亲的病好像不太要紧，他在家中随意走动，既不喘也不觉得眩晕，

en.t: My father's illness did not seem very serious; he moved about freely at home, neither short of breath nor feeling dizzy,

units.source_text: 只是脸色比正常人差多了。

en.t: only his complexion was much worse than that of an ordinary healthy person.

units.source_text: 不过，这也不是现在才有的病状，所以我们也没有特别放在心上。

en.t: But this was not a symptom that had only just appeared, so we did not pay it any special attention.

units.source_text: 我给先生写了一封信，感谢他借给我钱，告诉他等过了年回东京时，再把钱还给他。

en.t: I wrote Sensei a letter, thanking him for lending me money and telling him that I would repay him when I returned to Tokyo after the New Year.

units.source_text: 还写了父亲的病并不像想象的那么坏，暂时可以放心，

en.t: I also wrote that my father's illness was not as bad as I had imagined and that, for the time being, there was no need to worry,

units.source_text: 晕眩和呕吐之类的现象都没有等等。

en.t: and that there were no symptoms such as dizziness or vomiting.

units.source_text: 最后还问候了一句先生的感冒好了没有，其实我并没有怎么惦记他的感冒。

en.t: At the end I also asked whether Sensei's cold had improved, though in truth I had not been very concerned about it.

units.source_text: 给先生写信的时候，我根本没有想到先生会回信。

en.t: When I wrote to Sensei, I never imagined that he would write back.

units.source_text: 信发出去以后，我一边跟父母讲述这位先生的事，一边遥想着先生的书房。

en.t: After sending the letter, I told my parents about Sensei while picturing his study from far away.

units.source_text: “下次去东京，给他带些香菇吧。”

en.t: "Next time you go to Tokyo, take him some shiitake mushrooms."

units.source_text: “好的，不知先生吃不吃这种干香菇。”

en.t: "All right. I wonder whether Sensei eats this kind of dried shiitake."

units.source_text: “虽然不大好吃，可也没有人不喜欢吃吧。”

en.t: "They may not be especially tasty, but surely no one dislikes them."

units.source_text: 我觉得把香菇和先生联系起来很是别扭。

en.t: It felt very odd to me to connect shiitake mushrooms with Sensei.

units.source_text: 接到先生的回信时，我有点意外，

en.t: When I received Sensei's reply, I was a little surprised,

units.source_text: 尤其是看到信里没有什么要紧的事，更让我惊讶。

en.t: and I was even more surprised when I saw that there was nothing important in the letter.

units.source_text: 我觉得先生回信只是出于对我的关心，

en.t: I felt that Sensei had written back simply out of concern for me,

units.source_text: 这样一想，这封简短的回信使我高兴万分，

en.t: and thinking of it that way, this brief reply made me extremely happy,

units.source_text: 这毕竟是我接到的第一封先生的信。

en.t: for after all, it was the first letter I had ever received from Sensei.
